task.instruction: Find a hotel in Ohio From December 20th to December 23th for 3 adults and 2 rooms.

final_answer:
I ran the search on Booking.com for Ohio, United States. It is set for Dec 20 – Dec 23, 2026 (3 nights), 3 adults and 2 rooms, and it returned 2,842 properties.

The top result, sorted by "Top Picks for Groups", is "Walk to Lake Erie Renovated 2BR Huron Home Near Cedar Point & Kalahari" in Huron. It is an entire vacation home with 2 bedrooms and 4 beds. Guests rate it 9.7 (Exceptional, 17 reviews). It has free parking and free cancellation. The price is MYR 1,086, down from MYR 1,207, plus MYR 801 in taxes and fees. That price is for 3 nights and 3 adults, so it may not cover the 2-room setup.

You didn't say which hotel to book, so I haven't booked anything. I can narrow the results by city (Cleveland, Cincinnati or Columbus), property type (Hotels), star rating or budget. I can also open a specific property if you want one.

judge.rationale: The final page shows Booking.com results for Ohio, Dec 20–23, 2026, 3 adults, 2 rooms, and the agent reported a supported hotel result.
